name: Published PINDER evaluation harness and FroDock docking adapter
build_note: Published alternatives: pip installs released PINDER; Docker builds external FroDock baseline and invokes dependency installations and ./compile_frodock.sh in linked Dockerfile. No commands executed. External archive unavailable; pip release version not pinned by published install command. Code commit pins inspected PINDER source only.

run_commands.command: pinder_methods predict -m <method> -s <test set> -l <list of PINDER ids> -c `config` -r `results_dir`
run_commands.status: Verbatim published template, not a runnable fixed invocation; angle placeholders and backticks are documentation syntax.
Published required CLI interface; eval_dir must contain generated predictions in specified layout.

published_configuration.benchmark: PINDER-S; 250 holo pairs, 93 paired apo complexes
published_configuration.reason: Adapter requires n_solutions and force in config, but a complete published PINDER paper run configuration was not established. Intake fixed candidate count is a design choice, not a published baseline setting.

external_baseline.reason: Inspected public tree supplies documentation only; required software archive not obtained. Do not substitute README demonstration results for PINDER-S measurements.

published_performance_reason: No PINDER-S FroDock performance table independently verified in this bounded pass. No recovery rate, timing or reproduction tolerance invented.
blockers: FroDock source archive required by the published baseline Dockerfile was not obtained; its linked download page returned HTTP 404. Public chaconlab/FRODOCK repository tree inspected contains documentation and assets, not executable source.

Published PINDER method runner uses pandas.from_csv, and FroDock adapter contains apparent path concatenation and wildcard shutil.copy defects. These are source-inspection findings, not reproduction results.
No immutable pin or hash for the external FroDock software archive was established.
All 93 paired-apo input files and their mappings were not individually verified. Published README warns that archives omit some manifest files.
Representative runtime, peak CPU/GPU memory, fixed repeat count, and independent seed values are unavailable; no build or workload was run.
